description: Searches the signed-in person's Google Drive, including files shared with them. Returns file ids, names, types, modified times and owners — not contents. Read-only. Sign-in required.

max_results.description: Max files, newest modified first, 1-25. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Drive search, e.g. "retainer" or "name contains 'retainer'" or "mimeType = 'application/pdf'".

name: search_my_drive
title: Search my Drive
